stemMd:
The new walkway follows the edge of the marsh, ______ visitors can observe the habitat without crossing the areas where birds nest. The route also includes several raised viewing platforms.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanationMd: The comma and coordinating conjunction so join the independent clauses while expressing a result. The alternative adverbs do not provide the same grammatical clause connection.

distractorRationale.c: Therefore cannot join independent clauses with just the preceding comma.
distractorRationale.b: This conjunctive adverb would require a semicolon or period before it.
distractorRationale.d: Thus is not the coordinating conjunction required at this boundary.
